dedupe_keys.name: gwl fcs30 global 30 m wetland map with a fine classification system 2020

description: GWL_FCS30 is the first global 30 m wetland map with a fine classification system, for the year 2020. Liangyun Liu, Xiao Zhang and Tingting Zhao released it on Zenodo in November 2022, produced by combining pre-existing products with time series of multi-source remote sensing imagery on the Google Earth Engine platform. It separates five inland wetland classes (permanent water, swamp, marsh, flooded flat and saline) and three coastal tidal classes (mangrove, salt marsh and tidal flat). Coverage is global at 30 m. Format and access: twelve ZIP archives of tiles by longitude band, about 2.4 GB in total, downloaded from Zenodo. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: it is a single-year snapshot, and fine wetland classes are harder to separate than open water, so class accuracy varies by region. Wetlands and mangroves act as natural flood and storm buffers, so the map supports hazard exposure and climate adaptation studies of green-blue infrastructure. Related catalogue records are the Global Lakes and Wetlands Database v2 and the US National Wetlands Inventory.
